bugs.error_message: SECURITY: Apps Script notify route had no authentication â€” anyone with the public /exec URL (shipped in the JS bundle) could email arbitrary content to all opted-in members
bugs.root_cause: doPost routed action:'notify' straight to handleNotify without any credential check; the web app is deployed with access 'Anyone'
bugs.fix: Added NOTIFY_TOKEN check (Script Properties) in doPost; scripts/notify.js now sends the token read from .env.local/env. Requires redeploying Apps Script + setting the NOTIFY_TOKEN script property. Also: server-side field sanitization (clean()), email regex gate before confirmation email, generic error responses (no String(err) echo), payment API no longer leaks err.message, CSP + security headers in vercel.json, PII removed from localStorage backup.
